name: duowave-speak
description: Voice notifications for AI coding agents: says out loud, in one sentence, when the agent is done or needs you. Uses your computer's own voice in any language; with DuoWave, a speaker in the room.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the phrases, e.g. en-US, de, ru. Picks a matching system voice. Leave empty for the system default.

voice.title: System voice
voice.description: A voice name, e.g. Samantha on macOS. Leave empty for the default voice.

duowave_url.title: DuoWave address (optional)
duowave_url.description: To speak through DuoWave (https://duowave.ai): its address, e.g. http://localhost:7780. Leave empty to use the system voice.

duowave_key.title: DuoWave access key (optional)
duowave_key.description: A key from DuoWave: Settings → People and access → Access keys, with the right “Speak through the speaker” (and “Conversation, time, date” for DuoWave’s voice on the computer).

duowave_target.title: Where DuoWave speaks
duowave_target.description: auto (a speaker if one is connected, otherwise the computer), speaker, or computer.
